description: Ministry of Community and Social Services, critical infrastructure is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Children, Community and Social Services. Critical infrastructure information includes the following details about buildings that have Ministry of Community and Social Services/Ministry of Children and Youth Services occupants: address programs lead ministries. Coverage: Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Children, Community and Social Services. Its tags are Gouvernement, Government, Housing Communities and Social Support, Infrastructure and Transportation, Infrastructure et transport. The portal shows 2021-01-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
